title: Testing if 60 minutes of silence drives you crazy
summary: Veritasium's Derek Muller spends an hour in a silent, dark anechoic chamber at BYU to test the claim that 45 minutes is the most anyone can bear. He reports on his experience and other people's reactions.
why: HN links it in threads about silence and quiet rooms, as a good first-hand look at the anechoic chamber that debunks the madness myth.

quote.text: Derek from Veritasium has a good video on it for the interested.
